reviews.author: Gary Bolser
reviews.text: Eddie with Tidewater Recovery and Towing was able to winch out my commercial dumpster rental truck within ten minutes from being on site. He used soft shackles to make sure he didn’t damage my truck which I really appreciated. 100% would recommend.

reviews.author: Maria BoRad
reviews.text: Very professional & attentive & quick! Involved in community events with donations & true to his word. Family oriented.. I’ve used before for help with a car engine & came thru. Will always call for his help.

reviews.author: Randy Rodriguez
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Tidewater Recovery & Towing and highly recommend them. A few weeks ago, I needed my Blazer towed to get the throttle body replaced, and they really came through when I needed it most. Eddie showed up right on time, was professional, and handled my vehicle with extreme care. My Blazer sits low, and I was a bit worried about potential damage, but he took his time and made sure everything was done safely and properly. That level of care and attention really stood out. The entire process was smooth, stress free, and exactly what you hope for in a tough situation. You can tell they take pride in their work and genuinely care about their customers. If you’re looking for a reliable and professional towing service, I highly recommend Tidewater Recovery & Towing ask for Eddie!

reviews.author: Ash Salgado
reviews.text: My car broke down and I was really stressed, but they arrived quickly and handled everything with professionalism and care. The driver was friendly, communicated clearly, and made sure my vehicle was loaded and transported safely. Fast response time, fair pricing, and excellent customer service from start to finish. I highly recommend them to anyone needing a reliable towing company! Thank you Tidewater Recovery & Towing

reviews.author: Shaun
reviews.text: Tidewater towing and Recovery, was super efficient fast and friendly service. Took awesome care of my low rider. A+++

reviews.author: Lee Arvie
reviews.text: Very reliable and fast professional service. Customer oriented and focused. Definitely will use again when needed.

reviews.author: Kenneth Hensley
reviews.text: Great company with great customer service! Prompt, professional, and very helpful. My go-to company if I ever need another tow!

reviews.author: Emily Block
reviews.text: Eddie was so professional and helpful! He was willing to even cross the terrible tunnel for us with traffic. Grateful for a dependable company to tow our car!

reviews.author: Avery Huizar
reviews.text: Eddie(the owner) was fantastic to deal with. saved us 4hours of waiting for AAA to show up. Eddie will now be our go to in the future for towing needs.

reviews.author: Erika Wilson
reviews.text: My son in law was involved in an accident and unfortunately was overcharged and had horrible response from the tow company that he initially called. After waiting four hours I called tidewater towing. Eddie was so helpful and calmed us down. When he was only a few minutes away the original ones finally showed and had already charged $400!!!! I called Eddie fully expecting to pay something for his trouble. He not only did not charge us anything but also talked us through information to get from this horrible company to see what steps could be taken to report them, get reimbursed etc. From now on- me and my family will ONLY use tidewater!

reviews.author: Gerritt Jeffress
reviews.text: I hold a deep appreciation for professionalism, accountability, and respect, and Tidewater Recovery and Towing exemplified those values from start to finish. During a challenging situation, their team responded with compassion, integrity, and a clear commitment to customer care. My property was handled with exceptional attention and respect, and their calm, professional approach brought reassurance during a stressful time. I am sincerely grateful for the outstanding service they provided and highly recommend Tidewater Recovery and Towing to anyone in need of dependable, first-class assistance thanks Eddie!

reviews.author: Joseph he for Hardeman
reviews.text: Tidewater Recovery & Towing is professional, provides quality service, and is always available to help you out of tight situations.

reviews.author: TINA HARDEMAN
reviews.text: Tidewater Recovery and Towing customer service is caring and compassionate. They handle your property with care. Thank you for taking care of me in my time of need.
